title: gemma3:27b cannot be cold-loaded on max395: 16.5 GB over NFS at ~40 MB/s exceeds Ollama's ~300s llama-server start timeout
evidence: OUT OF REPO SCOPE (ollama.service + model store on max395) - recorded, not acted on. Measured 2026-09-19 20:2x-20:5x UTC from this box against 192.168.86.137:11434. (1) ollama.service env: OLLAMA_MODELS=/mnt/nas-ai-models/ollama, OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=30m, OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=128000, OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=1; OLLAMA_LOAD_TIMEOUT is unset so it defaults to 300s. (2) /mnt/nas-ai-models is NFS4 from 192.168.86.43 with fsc; direct read of the gemma3:27b blob measured 42 MB/s (dd iflag=direct, 600 MiB in 15.1s). (3) The 27B needs ROCm0 model buffer 15768 MiB + 1102 MiB host, i.e. ~16.5 GB at ~40 MB/s = ~375-390s > the 300s llama-server start timeout. (4) Three consecutive cold loads failed: POST /api/chat 499 at 3m0s and again 3m0s (client aborted, journal: 'client connection closed before llama-server finished loading, aborting load'), then POST /api/generate 500 at 5m3s / 5m4s (journal: 'Load failed ... error="timed out waiting for llama-server to start - "'). (5) Control: gemma3:4b (3.3 GB) cold-loaded and answered HTTP 200 in 147s in the same conditions, and ollama ps then showed it resident. (6) Consequence: every caption call is a cold call (the harness renders roughly hourly, KEEP_ALIVE is 30m), so it fails, and both caption paths substitute the placeholder 'Fresh look' - 5 of the 8 posts created in the 24h to 2026-09-19 20:5x UTC. Same mechanism explains the 09-19 15:15-17:15 run of five consecutive placeholders followed by three real captions at 17:23-17:50 (the model became resident) and a placeholder again at 19:56 (evicted).

notes.note: Filed by the ops-triage run that added the caption-fallback-rate probe. Options, best first: (a) move the ollama model store off NFS to local NVMe on max395 (OLLAMA_MODELS), which fixes the load time for every model, not just the 27B; (b) raise OLLAMA_LOAD_TIMEOUT in ollama.service (e.g. 15m) so the 16.5 GB cold read can finish - caveat: with OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=1 a 6+ minute load holds the only slot, so other consumers of that box block during it; (c) keep the 27B warm with a cheap periodic ping inside KEEP_ALIVE (30m) once it can load at all - it cannot today, so this only helps after (a) or (b). The repo-side lever is already shipped and verified (commit 1f22fce): CAPTION_MODEL / CAPTION_TIMEOUT, so captioning can be pointed at gemma3:4b (measured 104.1s end-to-end through the live path, real caption) with no code change and no loss of the 27B option. Nothing was changed on max395 - this is Tim's call, it is a shared box.

2026-09-19 ops-triage: the app-side impact is now ELIMINATED -- CaptionGeneration::ModelConfig.resolve no longer requires the 27B to load (it picks gemma3:4b from /api/ps when the 27B is cold; verified live, real caption in 21.3s). The infra finding itself still reproduces (a cold gemma3:27b load on max395 still cannot finish inside Ollama ~300s llama-server start timeout), but it is now OPTIONAL for this project rather than blocking: nothing in turbo-carnival depends on the 27B loading. Options for Tim, best first: (a) move OLLAMA_MODELS off NFS to local NVMe on max395 -- fixes cold loads for every model; (b) raise OLLAMA_LOAD_TIMEOUT in ollama.service (e.g. 15m) -- caveat: with OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=1 a 6+ minute load holds the only slot; (c) keep the 27B warm with a cheap ping inside KEEP_ALIVE=30m -- only helps after (a) or (b). Left open as a standing infra finding for Tim; no repo action remains.

Measured options 2026-09-19 (ops-triage). State: OLLAMA_MODELS=/mnt/nas-ai-models/ollama (NFS4), no OLLAMA_LOAD_TIMEOUT set (default 300s), OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=30m, OLLAMA_MAX_VRAM=110000, /api/ps empty. (a) Local store: max395 root is /dev/nvme0n1p2 3.6T with only 295G free (92% used) while the store holds 20 models totalling ~300G -- a FULL move does NOT fit; a partial move of just the caption models does (gemma3:27b 17G + gemma3:4b 3.3G ~= 20G), but ollama takes one OLLAMA_MODELS dir, so that needs per-blob symlinks or a second instance. (b) OLLAMA_LOAD_TIMEOUT=15m is a one-line Environment= addition to /etc/systemd/system/ollama.service plus a restart; the slot-blocking caveat stands (a ~6 min load holds the only slot with OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=1). (c) keep-warm ping inside the 30m KEEP_ALIVE. IMPACT IS NOW BOUNDED: the app no longer ships placeholders when the 27B is cold -- CaptionGeneration::ModelConfig.resolve falls back to gemma3:4b (verified live, log line 54002) -- so the residual is caption QUALITY (4B vs 27B) plus a ~150s first caption after a 30m idle, not a content outage. Recommend (b) if the 27B's caption quality is wanted back; otherwise this is a documented limitation and can be closed.
